```{r}

library(ggrepel)

source("pir_source.R")
source("homeless_source.R")
```

## Homelessness in MA in 2024

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total number of infants and children 0-5 that are homeless in MA"

ma_homeless_total_2024 <- ed_totals_under_5 |>
  filter(STATENAME == "MASSACHUSETTS" & YEAR_END == 2024) |>
  select(HOMELESS_UNDER_5_GRADE_1) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "123",
  color = "secondary",
  value = ma_homeless_total_2024
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Proportion of the infants and children 0-5 that are homeless in MA"

ma_homeless_percent_2024 <- ed_totals_under_5 |>
  filter(STATENAME == "MASSACHUSETTS" & YEAR_END == 2024) |>
  select(PERCENT_UNDER_5_HOMELESS) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "secondary",
  value = round(ma_homeless_percent_2024, 2)
)
```

## Temporal Visualizations

```{r}
options(scipen = 999)
ed_totals_under_5 |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(ST == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           ST != "MA" ~ "Other States")) |>
  group_by(YEAR_END, is_ma) |>
  filter(!is.na(is_ma)) |>
  summarize(homeless_children = sum(HOMELESS_UNDER_5_GRADE_1, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_population = sum(POPULATION_UNDER_5, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(YEAR_END) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           is_ma != "MA" ~ "USA"),
         homeless_children = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ homeless_children,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(homeless_children, na.rm = TRUE)),
         total_population = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ total_population,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(total_population)),
         ,
      percent_homeless = homeless_children / total_population * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR_END, y = percent_homeless, col = is_ma, group = is_ma)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "% Homeless Children",
       col = "",
       title = paste("Homeless Population via Grade 1 Proxy, ",
                     min(ed_totals_under_5$YEAR_END), 
                     "-" , 
                     max(ed_totals_under_5$YEAR_END))) +
  theme_minimal()  +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent_homeless, 2)), 
            vjust = -0.25)

```

```{r}
options(scipen = 999)
combined_pir |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(State == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           State != "MA" ~ "Other States")) |>
  group_by(pir_year, is_ma) |>
  filter(!is.na(is_ma)) |>
  summarize(homeless_children = sum(C.48, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_child_enroll = sum(A.10.g, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(pir_year) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           is_ma != "MA" ~ "USA"),
         homeless_children = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ homeless_children,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(homeless_children, na.rm = TRUE)),
         total_child_enroll = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ total_child_enroll,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(total_child_enroll)),
         ,
      percent_homeless = homeless_children / total_child_enroll * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pir_year, y = percent_homeless, col = is_ma, group = is_ma)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = min(combined_pir$pir_year):max(combined_pir$pir_year)) +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "% Enrolled Homeless Children",
       col = "",
       title = paste("Head Start Homeless Enrollments, ",
                     min(combined_pir$pir_year), 
                     "-" , 
                     max(combined_pir$pir_year))) +
  theme_minimal()  +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent_homeless, 2)), 
            vjust = -0.25)

```

## Rankings

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "MA Ranking: percent of children enrolled in Head Start that are homeless "

percent_homeless_table <-
  combined_pir |>
  group_by(pir_year, State) |>
  summarize(total_child_enroll = sum(A.10.g, na.rm = TRUE), 
      total_homeless_enroll = sum(C.48, na.rm = TRUE),
      num_homeless_na = sum(is.na(C.48)),
      percent_homeless = round(total_homeless_enroll / total_child_enroll * 100, 2)) |>
  arrange(desc(percent_homeless)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(pir_year) |>
  mutate(state_rank = rank(-percent_homeless, ties.method = "min")) |>
  ungroup()

ma_state_rank <- percent_homeless_table |>
  filter(State == "MA" & pir_year == 2024) |>
  select(state_rank) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "award",
  color = "secondary",
  value = ma_state_rank
)
```

```{r}
library(DT)
percent_homeless_table |>
  filter(pir_year == 2024 & (State == "MA" | state_rank <= 5)) |>
  select(State, 
         `% Homeless Enrolled` =  percent_homeless) |>
  datatable()

```

```{r}
library(leaflet)
library(tigris)
library(sf)
us_states <- states(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m") |>
  left_join(percent_homeless_table |>
              filter(pir_year == 2024), by = c("STUSPS" = "State")) |>
  st_transform(4326)

pal_bin_state_rank <- colorBin(palette="BuGn", 
                    domain = us_states$percent_homeless,
                    bins = 5)

usa_map <- leaflet(width = "100%") %>%
  setView(lat = 30, lng = -95, zoom = 3) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.NatGeoWorldMap) |> addPolygons(data = us_states, 
              weight = 1,
              color = "black",
              fillColor = ~pal_bin_state_rank(percent_homeless),
              fillOpacity = 0.8) |>
  addLegend(data = us_states,
            title = "% Homeless Enrolled HS", 
            pal = pal_bin_state_rank, 
            values = ~percent_homeless)

usa_map
```



## Overview of Homeless Counts from Different Sources

```{r}
ed_totals_under_5 |>
  mutate(HOMELESS_3_5_655 = as.numeric(HOMELESS_3_5_655),
         HOMELESS_0_5_818 = as.numeric(HOMELESS_0_5_818)) |>
  select(STATENAME, 
         YEAR_END, 
         HOMELESS_UNDER_5_GRADE_1,
         HOMELESS_3_5_655, 
         HOMELESS_0_5_818, 
         TOTAL_HS_HOMELESS_ENROLL) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(HOMELESS_UNDER_5_GRADE_1, 
               HOMELESS_3_5_655, 
               HOMELESS_0_5_818, 
               TOTAL_HS_HOMELESS_ENROLL),
               names_to = "HOMELESS_MEASURE",
               values_to = "HOMELESS_COUNT") |>
  mutate(HOMELESS_MEASURE = case_when(HOMELESS_MEASURE == "HOMELESS_UNDER_5_GRADE_1" ~
                                        "Grade 1 Proxy Method",
                                      HOMELESS_MEASURE == "HOMELESS_3_5_655" ~
                                        "Chidren 3-5 Enrolled in Public Schools (File 655)",
                                      HOMELESS_MEASURE == "HOMELESS_0_5_818" ~
                                        "Children 0-5 Served by McKinney-Vento subgrant funds (File 818)",
                                      HOMELESS_MEASURE == "TOTAL_HS_HOMELESS_ENROLL" ~
                                        "Homeless Children Enrolled in Head Start")) |>
  filter(STATENAME == "MASSACHUSETTS") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR_END, y = HOMELESS_COUNT, col = HOMELESS_MEASURE, group = HOMELESS_MEASURE)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 5))  +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = HOMELESS_COUNT), 
            vjust = -0.5,
            size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Homeless Count")
  
```


## By Shelter Type

Shelter type is not reported disaggregated by grade. We took the percentage of K-12 students in each shelter type, each year for each state and multiplied that percentage by the number of homeless children under 5 identified via the Grade 1 proxy method

```{r}
ed_totals_under_5_char |>
  filter(STATENAME == "MASSACHUSETTS") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR_END, y = TOTAL_CHAR_UNDER_5, fill = Characteristics)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.9) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(TOTAL_CHAR_UNDER_5, 0)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            size = 3,
            vjust = -0.25  )
```


```{r}
ed_totals_under_5_char |>
  filter(STATENAME == "MASSACHUSETTS") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR_END, y = TOTAL_CHAR_UNDER_5, fill = Characteristics)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste(as.character(round(PERCENT_CHAR_ST_YR, 4) * 100) , "%")),
            position = position_fill(),
            size = 3,
            vjust = -0.25  )
```
